mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.cid, p.name, p.total_credit_required, p.required_credit_required, p.elective_credit_required, c.name AS clazz_name FROM training_plan p LEFT JOIN clazz c ON c.cid = p.cid ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id, p.cid, p.name, p.total_credit_required, p.required_credit_required, p.elective_credit_required, c.name AS clazz_name FROM training_plan p LEFT JOIN clazz c ON c.cid = p.cid WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.cid, p.name, p.total_credit_required, p.required_credit_required, p.elective_credit_required, c.name AS clazz_name FROM training_plan p LEFT JOIN clazz c ON c.cid = p.cid WHERE p.cid = #{cid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_plan (cid, name, total_credit_required, required_credit_required, elective_credit_required) VALUES (#{cid}, #{name}, #{totalCreditRequired}, #{requiredCreditRequired}, #{electiveCreditRequired})
mapper.update: UPDATE training_plan SET cid = #{cid}, name = #{name}, total_credit_required = #{totalCreditRequired}, required_credit_required = #{requiredCreditRequired}, elective_credit_required = #{electiveCreditRequired} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pc.plan_id, pc.course_id, pc.type, pc.require_credit, c.name AS course_name, c.credit AS course_credit FROM plan_course pc LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = pc.course_id WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY pc.type, pc.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_course (plan_id, course_id, type, require_credit) VALUES (#{planId}, #{courseId}, #{type}, #{requireCredit})
